ordered_diagnoses: Severe sepsis due to gram-negative rods

s1.syndrome_frame: Acute presentation of a febrile and hypotensive patient with a history of recent infection and worsening fatigue, malaise, and signs of bleeding diathesis
salient_findings: Nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea
Productive cough and dyspnea on exertion
Nonblanchable, petechial rash over bilateral lower extremities
Leukocytosis with granulocytosis
Thrombocytopenia with a significant drop in platelet count
Gram-negative rods in blood cultures
key_facts: 80-year-old woman with a history of hypertension, gout, and osteoarthritis
Presented with several days of nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea
Had a productive cough and dyspnea on exertion for the past two weeks
Progressively worsening fatigue and severe malaise
No new medications were started in the past several weeks
Poor oral intake for several weeks
Consumption of 3-4 glasses of wine daily
Sustained a dog bite on her right thumb approximately one week before admission
Afebrile on presentation
Tachycardic with a heart rate of 122 beats/min
Hypotensive with a blood pressure of 95/55 mm Hg
Clear lungs on auscultation
Soft and nontender abdomen
Leukocytosis with a white blood cell count of 18.4 × 10⁹/L
Thrombocytopenia with a platelet count of 99 × 10⁹/L
Previous platelet count was 503 × 10⁹/L
Gram stain of blood cultures showed thin, fusiform gram-negative rods

shortlist.label: Neisseria meningitidis sepsis
shortlist.why_kept: Petechial rash and hypotension, although patient is afebrile

shortlist.label: Disseminated intravascular coagulation

raw.rationale: The patient's history of a dog bite and the presence of thin, fusiform gram-negative rods in the blood cultures are consistent with Capnocytophaga canimorsus sepsis, which is a known complication of dog bites.

rejected.label: Severe sepsis due to gram-negative rods
rejected.why: The presence of gram-negative rods in the blood cultures is consistent with sepsis, but the specific identification of Capnocytophaga canimorsus is more specific and relevant to the patient's history

rejected.label: Thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura
rejected.why: There is no evidence of microangiopathic hemolytic anemia or other characteristic features of TTP
